description.value: Fountain Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant situated in Blanshard Square in central Victoria, BC. The establishment offers dine-in, takeout, and online ordering, with delivery also available for those staying nearby. Its location in a commercial plaza in a busy part of the city makes it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the area.
